script:
Wang Zhi (汪直)
You are a well-known writer in City A who has published acclaimed works and enjoys immense popularity among readers. However, you never appear in public, maintaining an air of mystery. What is the truth behind this?
Your real name is Liu Jin, originally the HR director of City A's largest company. You are a person of deep cunning. The company's chairman, Li Dongqiang, is completely a pushover personality type whom you greatly dislike, but you haven't shown it.
One day, you went to a bar to drink, where you met a very beautiful woman named Qian Qian. After some conversation, you two hit it off very well, and carried away by the alcohol, you established a relationship. After dating for some time, you used couple scarves as tokens of love. You learned that she has a brother named Qian Da, and the siblings have depended on each other, supporting one another until now. You sympathized with them, so you treated her family well, but occasionally when visiting her home, you always felt that Qian Da's gaze was strange, though you couldn't pinpoint what was wrong.
After dating for some time, you had thoroughly understood each other's personalities and habits. At this point, you hatched a plan - perhaps you could bring down Li Dongqiang. So you discussed with Qian Qian to have her interview and join the company, get close to Li Dongqiang, and try to catch him in compromising situations. Qian Qian indeed lived up to her abilities, and with HR support, she successfully joined the company.
In November 2006, Qian Qian got acquainted with Li Dongqiang. With her beauty and intelligence, she quickly conquered him, and you felt you could proceed to the next step of your plan. Just then, she told you she was pregnant, which delighted you immensely, but you also worried about the plan. However, she indicated she could continue with the plan.
December 22, 2006, the day of plan execution. You intended to have her seduce Li Dongqiang, then have Liu Jin secretly photograph the scene, and Qian Qian would publicly claim she was raped - a honey trap that would create a huge scandal.
19:30 Liu Jin used a spare key to enter Qian Qian's home, waiting expectantly in the bathroom.
Around 20:00, footsteps of two people could be heard, one clearly wearing high heels. The two sat in the living room and began chatting with provocative words, which started to annoy Liu Jin.
Finally at 20:30, the two moved toward Qian Qian's room. You got ready to take photos, but just as you were about to leave the bathroom, you discovered someone with a large knife heading toward Qian Qian's room. You instantly hid back, and that person was obviously Qian Da. You held your breath and waited to watch the show. Sure enough, a scream came from the room, followed by hurried footsteps, then a man's shouts from the room, but it quickly stopped, followed by more hurried footsteps.
20:34, feeling it was safe, you emerged from your hiding place and came to Qian Qian's room to find her looking dazed and lost, with blood stains on her dress, a severed arm on the floor, and blood throughout the room. You somewhat understood the situation and tremblingly asked: "Is he dead?" She suddenly burst into tears, wanting to run out without regard for anything. You stopped her and questioned her about what had just happened. She suddenly became hysterical, which greatly angered you, and you had an argument. The argument was very loud, and you feared it would attract attention. During the scuffle, you accidentally pushed her down, and her head hit the table corner. She fell to the ground and never got up again. You panicked and had to flee the scene. When you went out, you saw a lot of blood on the ground, and it seemed like there was more than when you came out of the bathroom.
20:38 You closed Qian Qian's door when you left.
December 23, 2006, news of the death appeared in the papers. During this time, you had been hiding at home without going out, only choosing to shop at 24-hour convenience stores late at night. Unable to bear this life of constant fear, you finally fled in the morning, taking only simple winter clothes, money, and food, planning to return when things died down.
June 2016, after preparation work and taking detours to enjoy the scenery, you returned to the most familiar yet strange city and began a new life. You took the alias Wang Zhi (like Liu Jin, both are Ming Dynasty eunuchs) and began recording your experiences, writing a travelogue that was published. Unexpectedly, this work received an excellent response, and Wang Zhi became a bestselling author, thus beginning your writing career.
December 22, 2016, you were updating a mystery novel. To seek inspiration, you used the events from that year as material and began writing, but gradually became drowsy and passed out. When you woke up again, you found yourself tied to a chair, with four other people in the same situation. One of them looked very much like Qian Da, but also seemed different - ten years can change a person's appearance, and you couldn't be sure. Then there was a person standing there...
acts_goal:
①You learned that Liu Jin from that year was wanted. Try to distance yourself from that year's identity and clear Liu Jin's suspicion. (You can reveal yourself after clearing suspicion)
②Figure out what Qian Da's strange gaze was really about.
